summary.zh-Hant: 奧匈帝國與蒙特內哥羅開戰

citations.evidenceNote: 駐維也納大使 1914-08-10 電：「Austria-Hungary declared war against Montenegro 9th instant.」

timeNote.zh-Hant: 蒙特內哥羅 8 月 5 日對奧匈宣戰為通行說法（待查證）；本表取 FRUS 所記奧匈宣戰日 8 月 9 日。
timeNote.en: Montenegro is usually said to have declared war on 5 Aug (pending); FRUS records the Austro-Hungarian declaration of 9 Aug.
